meta.name: Hello!
meta.description:
Life changes for Nandita when she receives a series of MMS with romantic messages that expose her husband Ananya's extra-marital affair with Nina. As the mystery thickens, Nandita realises that the MMS can actually be aimed at her.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 25 Sept 2017 · India · Language: Bengali · 17 min
Studio: Hoichoi · Network: hoichoi

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 7/8 (missing E8) | S3 12/12

On your server — Audio: Bengali, Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: You Have One New Message
videos.overview: Life changes for Nandita when she receives a MMS from an unknown number, showcasing her husband Ananyo making love to Nina.

videos.title: The Number is Blocked
videos.overview: Ananyo, angered, tries to find the intruder who shot the MMS. Meanwhile, an unknown man delivers Nandita a gift box, containing a finger ring, not her size.

videos.title: Try Again Later
videos.overview: Ananyo accuses Nandita for having a secret affair with the sender of the ring. Nandita receives another MMS and learns that the sender's name is Debol Shome.

videos.title: Inbox Full
videos.overview: Nandita visits a Puja pandal to catch Ananyo red-handed with Nina but in vain. Nandita keeps getting the series of MMS, complicating her married life even more.

videos.title: Wrong Number
videos.overview: During Sandhya Arati, Nandita notices Nina but barely recognises her. Later when Ananyo returns, his son finds something written on his palm.

videos.title: Insufficient Balance
videos.overview: Nandita suspects a link between all the MMS and the mystery about Debal Shome deepens. Meanwhile, Nina is all praises for Nandita, which leaves Ananyo confused.

videos.title: Hold the Line
videos.overview: Nandita visits a pub where the mysterious Debal Shome had asked to meet her. Nandita notices Nina, dressed like her. When Ananyo confronts her, Nina declines.

videos.title: The Line is Busy
videos.overview: A perplexed Nandita decides to leave. But then something happens, which completely leaves her shocked. Will the mystery regarding Debal Shome be solved?

videos.title: She Is Mine
videos.overview: The lives of Nandita and Ananyo take several turns. Nandita finds herself at Nina's place, where the latter is seen ridiculing Ananyo for judging her wrong.

videos.title: Belphool
videos.overview: Nandita and Ananyo hurl blame games on each other, while it's time for some messages from an unknown number, this time to be received by Ananyo.

videos.title: Ke eshechilo ghore?
videos.overview: Anonyo is angry about Nandita getting intimate with Nina who finds a bloody handkerchief and starts to doubt Anonyo for behaving strangely.

videos.title: Love, liar, loft
videos.overview: Anonyo is shocked and scared to see some unexpected guests at his door, one after the other. Will Anonyo's misdeeds be finally caught?

videos.title: Laal Lipstick
videos.overview: Ananyo suffers from an accident while trying to escape the bizarre situations and Nina's visions. Who is trying to trap him?

videos.title: She Is Coming For Us
videos.overview: Nandita and Ananyo start coming close to each other amidst all the complications, but someone is keeping a watch on all of their activities.

videos.title: Lakkhi Thakur Confusing
videos.overview: Ananyo’s family is busy preparing for Lakshmi Puja, while suddenly few unwanted guests arrive at his place searching for him.

videos.title: The Past Is Prologue
videos.overview: In the market, Ananyo crashes his car seeing Nandita and Nina together. Nina reveals to Nandita that they were in the same college.

videos.title: The Masked Man
videos.overview: Nina tears up the invitation to their college reunion unknown to Nandita, but Barna comes to Nina's place handing Nandita the invitation. Ananyo meets a girl called Riya.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Nina and Nandita go to the masquerade reunion together. A mysterious man whispers in Nina's ears sending her into a shock.

videos.title: Double Or Nothing
videos.overview: Nina receives a strange message asking her to meet the sender. Nandita meets Ananyo in a café, and Ananyo steals her house keys.

videos.title: Trail Of Truth
videos.overview: Nina meets the mysterious man and tries to bribe him to leave Nandita alone. In a party, Ananyo tries to record Nina dancing.

videos.title: The Festive Fiasco
videos.overview: Nandita arrives at Ananyo's house on Ashtami. On the way back from pandal hopping, Nandita finds a piece of paper in her bag making her panic.

videos.title: The Devil In Black
videos.overview: Nina realises that Rangeet is following her. While in the construction site, something terrible happens to Arijit.

videos.title: Behind The Bars
videos.overview: Nandita chances upon Ananyo when Nina is arrested. Nandita visits Nina in her cell, and she says Ananyo is behind all this.

videos.title: Sip Of Sins
videos.overview: A pen drive is delivered to Nandita with Ananyo's confessions. In a party, Nandita gets to know that Rangit had raped a woman back in college

videos.title: Dawn Of Death
videos.overview: Nina tries to shut Rangit up again but fails. Nandita gets her divorce papers from the lawyer.

videos.title: A Burden Of Blood
videos.overview: There's an intruder in Nina's house. As Nina is being strangled to death, Nandita comes to her rescue.

videos.title: Check Mate
videos.overview: Nandita reveals the story about her shadowy past with Rangit. There is an unknown fate awaiting Nina.
